metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-19490: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.. Product: NetScaler
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message has "CVE-2026-19490" or RuleName has "CVE-2026-19490" or ProcessName has "CVE-2026-19490" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, EventID | where count_ > 5 // AZ-GENERAL-007
